2608.30165.title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents
2608.30165.paper_summary: Scientific progress depends not only on finding solutions, but on learning the rules that explain why they work and using that understanding to design better experiments. We introduce science sandboxes, a framework for studying this capability in AI agents through repeated cycles of experimentation, feedback, and hypothesis revision. Science sandboxes invite an agent to query the natural world in different ways, ranging from "wet" physical experiments, to "damp" predictive models trained on empirical data, to "dry" invented rules. By establishing a common experimental loop and a protocol for evaluating agents within it, science sandboxes allow assessment of both quantitative performance on specific metrics and qualitative scientific reasoning, across a spectrum of empirical verifiability. Here, we instantiate this framework in two biological settings, models of regulatory genomics and protein fitness prediction, and examine the capabilities of frontier agents. Across these settings, we could see when agents successfully optimized a quantitative metric without understanding the rules underlying the system. In particular, their scientific reasoning deteriorated when they encountered systems whose rules fell outside familiar biological priors. By highlighting such failure modes, science sandboxes make the frontier of scientific capability measurable and provide a controlled setting in which to study and ultimately expand it.
2608.30165.paper_summary_zh: 科學進展不僅依賴於找到解決方案，還依賴於學習解釋為什麼這些解決方案有效的規則，並利用這種理解來設計更好的實驗。<lb/>我們引入科學沙箱，這是一個通過重複的實驗、反饋和假設修訂循環來研究AI代理能力的框架。<lb/>科學沙箱邀請代理以不同的方式探詢自然世界，範圍從“濕”的物理實驗，到基於經驗數據訓練的“潮濕”預測模型，再到“乾燥”的發明規則。<lb/>通過建立一個共同的實驗循環和評估代理的協議，科學沙箱允許對特定指標的定量表現和質性科學推理進行評估，涵蓋一個經驗可驗證性的光譜。<lb/>在這裡，我們在兩個生物學環境中實現了這一框架，分別為調控基因組學模型和蛋白質適應性預測，並檢查前沿代理的能力。<lb/>在這些環境中，我們可以看到當代理成功優化一個定量指標時，卻沒有理解系統背後的規則。<lb/>特別是，當他們遇到規則超出熟悉的生物學先驗的系統時，他們的科學推理能力下降。<lb/>通過突顯這種失敗模式，科學沙箱使科學能力的前沿可測量，並提供了一個受控的環境來研究並最終擴展它。
